Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the attachments. I looped in Kimberly (Legal) and Marcus (Risk) to confirm the acceptance path. Two quick items from Redwood's side:

1) Coverage minimums: We need primary and non-contributory wording on General Liability and Waiver of Subrogation for Workers' Comp where permitted. Limits we expect: GL $5M aggregate, $1M per occurrence; Auto $1M combined single limit; E&O/Professional Liability $2M. If your broker needs to flag a divergence, call it out and we'll evaluate.

2) Additional Insured: We can accept a post-issuance endorsement delivered within 7 business days after execution (we typically ask for 10 but for this account we can compress to 7). The endorsement must reference both naming Redwood Inference, Inc. and Redwood IP Holdings LLC as additional insureds and provide ISO CG 20 10 or equivalent wording.

Kimberly — can you confirm if we need the endorsement on the COI face for procurement acceptance or whether the post-issue endorsement + delivery SLA is sufficient from Legal? Marcus, flag if the limits above are ok for the vertical.

Sarah — regarding signer type: delivery from the carrier (carrier-authorized rep or an electronic insurer-issued COI) is preferred. Broker-signed COIs are accepted only if they include a carrier signature block or stamp.

Next steps I propose:
- Kimberly confirms legal acceptance path (face vs endorsement)
- Triangle confirms whether broker can deliver the endorsement within 7 business days and whether carrier will sign a superseding endorsement
- If any limits deviate, Sarah to mark with redline and we will route to procurement for risk acceptance.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Strategic Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
